description: Regular penetration testing of systems and applications is not conducted. This signal indicates that exploitable vulnerabilities may exist without detection.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring offensive security testing. Includes network penetration tests, application security testing, and social engineering assessments.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through penetration testing program review, test schedule verification, and remediation tracking assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
